
Which fruit?

❯ 1. Apple
     A crisp, sweet fruit that comes in many varieties.
  2. Banana
     A soft, starchy fruit with a yellow peel.
  3. Cherry
     A small stone fruit, sweet or tart.
↓ 4. Date
     A sticky, very sweet fruit from a palm tree.
